decision.reasoning_trace: We considered 25 smartwatches with various features such as heart rate monitoring, blood oxygen measurement, and water resistance. We prioritized products with high ratings, recent reviews, and a balance of features and price. The Blackview Smart Watch (prod_smartwatches_117) stands out with a 4.3 rating, 924 reviews, and a price of $23.99, offering a good balance of features and affordability. Other products in the consideration set were the Polar M600 Sports Smart Watch (prod_smartwatches_158), the PlayZoom 2 Kids Smartwatch (prod_smartwatches_091), the Hadisala Smart Watch (prod_smartwatches_186), and the AMZSA Smart Watch (prod_smartwatches_035).
